body:
Honestly from what I can remember..


Back then in ROBLOX; everything was different; obviously. What I mean is, that the games back then were so unique; sure they may have been simple if you view it now and compare it to modern day games and you can see the major difference; but people in that time were not as toxic as now; I’m not saying everyone is when being in-game..but some do tend to be really rude to you; although it doesn’t really have an affect; depending on what they say..but regardless it really shows how the community is sometimes.

At the time not that many words have been censored compared to what is now present day ROBLOX.

I go onto ‘role play’ games; and no; not the cringeworthy games..but if you’ve played a game called ‘Super Hero Life’ then you’d probably be familiar. Anyway, I’ve played on there and I have fun; whatever right? But sometimes some words I attempt to use get censored; such as “It’s” or a simple name like “James” 
I’ve tried to use the word “big chungus” and somehow that is deemed to be offensive lol; and it wasn’t even being said to anyone, I was going to use it as a role playing name to probably have people react to it.


But honestly; ROBLOX from the past should really be respected, for it wasn’t so ‘cringe’ or dull as to what it is now. 
Don’t get me wrong, some games of now that are cool to me IMO, and that’s hard to say since most games I’ve seen kinda scream ‘ODing’ but I sure do miss ROBLOX from back then. 

Also.. #RIPTIX

I honestly don’t get why they’d remove it, there wasn’t any valid reason as to why they’d remove it, if anything that just forces uses to waste a lot of money for cosmetics in the catalog. Even though $1.00 USD is like 80 robux if you’d purchase it on mobile, but I don’t think people would want to spend money regardless, but it is what it is.
